observations: Photo 0: an industrial book sewing machine (thread sewing for book sections) in teal and cream, with a needle and hook bar under a clear plastic guard and a brown metal feed table in front.
Photo 0: the feed table is worn and scratched with rust marks; a cable runs loose across it; dust on the frame.
Photo 1: the same machine from the operator side, with a control panel of push buttons, a red and yellow main isolator switch, hand wheels, and a delivery arm on the right.
Photo 1: a small label on the cabinet reads something like 'CT 37' but it is not legible; no maker's name or model plate is readable in either photo.
Both photos carry a watermark 'OYOLAKFOM NIG LTD POSTED ON JIJI'.
Machine stands in a workshop or warehouse; it is not shown powered on or sewing.

identity.kind: industrial book sewing machine (thread sewing, print finishing)
read_from: photo 0 and photo 1 shape: needle bar, sewing saddle, feed table and delivery arm of a book sewing machine; no maker or model readable

claims.evidence: No clip of the machine running or a sewn sample is shown.
Photo 0 shows a worn, scratched and rust marked feed table and dust on the frame; this is a used machine.
Internal mechanisms and service history cannot be seen in photos.
No clip of it running and sewing a book block.
No receipt or warranty document is shown.

risks.risk: Make, model and year are unknown; these set the value of industrial binding equipment far more than the type does.
risks.proof: Close-up of the maker's plate showing brand, model, serial and year.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced; identity stays at type only.

risks.risk: Machine does not run or does not sew cleanly (worn needles, hooks, timing, motor or electrics).
risks.proof: Clip of the machine powered on, feeding and sewing several signatures, with the sewn result shown.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, for parts or rebuild.

risks.risk: Missing parts, tooling or the motor and electrical panel faulty.
risks.proof: Photos of the motor, electrical cabinet open, and the full set of needles and hooks.

risks.risk: Receipt and warranty do not exist or belong to another machine.
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt or import papers showing the same serial as the plate.

proof_requests: Sharp photo of the maker's plate with brand, model, serial number and year.
Clip of the machine running and sewing a book block, with the result shown.
Photos of the motor and the open electrical cabinet.
Photo of the receipt or import papers showing the serial.
response.reason: Both photos show a used industrial book sewing machine, but no maker or model plate is readable, and for this equipment the make and model set the price. The plate must be shown before even a worst case price is possible.
